source: Quantitative Finance, Prop Survivability (https://youtu.be/vGSpbspmGoM) & Stochastic Risk Modeling

effective_drawdown_budget.definition: The nominal account balance ($100) is cosmetic; the true capital you have to trade is the maximum allowable drawdown budget ($15 - $20).
effective_drawdown_budget.benchmark: On a $100 account with $20 max DD budget and $1.50 risk, the trader has exactly 13 units of life.

breakeven_win_rate.definition: Minimum win rate needed to achieve net zero EV at a given reward-to-risk ratio.

losing_streak_ruin_guarantee.definition: Probability of experiencing an unbroken cluster of k consecutive losses.
losing_streak_ruin_guarantee.safety_rule: Position sizing MUST guarantee surviving at least 8 consecutive losses (k=8) without breaching the drawdown floor.

absorbing_barrier_first_passage.definition: Probability of hitting the profit milestone target (+20%) before hitting the drawdown floor (-15%).
absorbing_barrier_first_passage.implication: Never size up during early epoch stages before empirical edge has established positive drift.

penalties.under_sizing_stagnation: < 0.4% risk requires too many trade steps, suffering regime decay before hitting profit milestones.
penalties.over_sizing_ruin: > 2.0% risk renders an account unable to survive a normal 5-to-7 loss sequence.

net_real_return_accounting.philosophy: True compounding is measured by capital successfully extracted into the vault minus capital burned across resets.

hurst_exponent_regimes.trending: H > 0.55 -> Execute momentum trend continuation and one-time framing.
hurst_exponent_regimes.mean_reverting: H < 0.45 -> Execute Value Area boundary fading and liquidity sweeps.
hurst_exponent_regimes.random_walk_chop: 0.45 <= H <= 0.55 -> Pure Brownian random walk; automatically skip entries.
